compiled_state.title: Implement 5 named knobs in provision-ruleset.sh
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD: When this story is complete, provision-ruleset.sh accepts 5 named knobs: bypass_actor_policy (always|pull_request_only), require_conversation_resolution, request_copilot_review, dismiss_stale_approvals_on_push, required_approvals
- DD: When this story is complete, CodeQL and code-quality rules are deferred with a placeholder comment in provision-ruleset.sh noting the follow-on epic
- DD: When this story is complete, provision-ruleset.sh exits 1 with a clear error when insufficient token privileges for bypass_actor_policy changes

## Description
Add 5 named CLI knobs to plugins/dso/scripts/onboarding/provision-ruleset.sh. Each knob has a CLI flag and a default that matches the current hardcoded value (preserving backward compatibility). Knobs map to the existing JSON payload fields:

| Knob | CLI flag | Default | Maps to |
|------|----------|---------|---------|
| bypass_actor_policy | --bypass-actor-policy=always|pull_request_only | always | bypass_actors[].bypass_mode |
| require_conversation_resolution | --require-conversation-resolution=true|false | false | rules[].pull_request.parameters.required_review_thread_resolution |
| request_copilot_review | --request-copilot-review=true|false | false | (see below) |
| dismiss_stale_approvals_on_push | --dismiss-stale-approvals-on-push=true|false | false | rules[].pull_request.parameters.dismiss_stale_reviews_on_push |
| required_approvals | --required-approvals=N | 1 | rules[].pull_request.parameters.required_approving_review_count |

### request_copilot_review handling

GitHub does NOT expose request_copilot_review as a Ruleset rule directly — Copilot code review is a repo-level setting (or a PR-time setting in the GitHub UI). Implementation options:

1. **PR auto-request via gh api**: emit an additional command in the script that uses 'gh api -X PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}' to set 'automatic_copilot_review' if/when GitHub exposes it. Today this field does not exist in the public API.
2. **Documented placeholder**: when --request-copilot-review=true is passed, log 'NOTE: Copilot review request is configured at PR-creation time, not via Ruleset. This flag is recorded in dso-config.conf for future automation when GitHub adds API support.' and continue.

Choose option 2 for now (documented placeholder). When GitHub exposes the API, switch to option 1.

### CodeQL / code-quality placeholder

Add a comment block before the rules[] array in the JSON payload:
'# CodeQL and code-quality rules are deferred to a follow-on epic. When that epic ships, add rule entries here for: required_workflows (CodeQL), and the code-quality check contexts.'

### Insufficient privileges error path

When --bypass-actor-policy is passed with a value other than the default AND 'gh auth status' detects token lacks admin scope, exit 1 with:
'ERROR: Setting bypass_actor_policy requires an admin token (admin:org or repo admin scope). Re-authenticate with: gh auth refresh -s admin:org'

Detect via 'gh auth status -t 2>&1 | grep -q "admin"' (or similar reliable check).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] 5 new CLI flags accepted: --bypass-actor-policy, --require-conversation-resolution, --request-copilot-review, --dismiss-stale-approvals-on-push, --required-approvals
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/onboarding/provision-ruleset.sh --help 2>&1 | grep -c -E 'bypass-actor-policy|require-conversation-resolution|request-copilot-review|dismiss-stale-approvals-on-push|required-approvals'
- [ ] All 6 RED tests now pass (GREEN)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-provision-ruleset.sh
- [ ] CodeQL placeholder comment present in script
  Verify: grep -q 'CodeQL.*follow-on epic' plugins/dso/scripts/onboarding/provision-ruleset.sh
- [ ] Insufficient-privileges error path implemented
  Verify: grep -q 'admin token\|admin:org' plugins/dso/scripts/onboarding/provision-ruleset.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context.
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user.
